s.t:
Du verantwortest unser CRM über drei Marken in drei Ländern – analytisch und operativ. Im Zentrum stehen Daten, Logik und Systeme: Du liest aus, wo Potenzial liegt, baust die Segmentierung dahinter und automatisierst, was sich automatisieren lässt.
Copy und Creative-Briefings produzierst du AI-gestützt selbst & erhältst unterstützung aus dem Team wo du es benötigst.
Aufgaben
Volle analytische und operative Verantwortung für das CRM über drei Marken in drei Ländern
Audit und Weiterentwicklung aller Klaviyo-Flows: Trigger-Logik, Segmentierungstiefe, Performance
A/B-Test-Framework etablieren: klare Hypothesen, Mindest-Laufzeiten, Auswertungslogik
AI-gestützte Produktion von Copy und Creative-Briefings über alle Brands
Vollautomatisiertes CRM-Reporting über Klaviyo MCP
Aufbau weiterer CRM-Kanäle: WhatsApp, SMS, Mailing
Qualifikation
Mehrjährige Erfahrung im CRM- oder Lifecycle-Marketing, idealerweise E-Commerce oder D2C
Tiefe Klaviyo-Erfahrung: Flows, Segmentierung, Custom Properties, Events
Du denkst in Daten, Logik und Systemen – nicht in Kampagnen-Ästhetik
Verständnis für Datenmodelle und Tracking: Du erkennst falsch ankommende Events, bevor es jemand anderem auffällt
Du arbeitest AI-first und produzierst Copy und Briefings selbst
Volle Eigenverantwortung: kein Copywriter, kein dedizierter Grafiker im Team
Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse

Über 1 Millionen Bestellungen, 5 Märkte, 3 Brands – hier passiert was. Du übernimmst echtes Ownership, statt nur Rädchen im Getriebe zu sein.
Flexible Arbeitszeitmodelle und Homeoffice-Option. Du entscheidest, wann und wo du am produktivsten bist
Dynamisches Team mit echter Kultur. Wöchentlicher Wanderpokal für gelebte Werte, gemeinsames feiern von Jubiläen und Geburtstagen und monatliche After-Work-Drinks
Deutschland-Ticket, 250 € Shopping-Budget in unseren eigenen Shops und weitere Benefits wie Urban Sports Club M
Jeden Monat eine neue Sportart, die wir im Lyto Athletics Club zusammen ausprobieren
Gemeinsame Team-Trips (Mallorca, Belgien, Portugal) und das beste Company Merch der Branche
Individuelles Coaching nach deinen Zielen – von Leadership bis Fach-Coaching, z. B. ein eigener Google-Ads-Coach

Enterprise Account Executive

Autodesk is seeking an Enterprise Account Executive to strategically grow and expand relationships across high-value enterprise accounts. This role is responsible for leading comprehensive account growth strategies, driving incremental revenue, expanding product adoption, and positioning Autodesk as a long-term strategic partner to customers undergoing digital transformation.
The Enterprise Account Executive will own strategic executive relationships, account planning, revenue generation, pipeline management, complex deal negotiations, and orchestration of cross-functional account teams. This role goes beyond execution: it requires the ability to refine and innovate account strategies, influence executive stakeholders, lead high-complexity commercial motions, and drive measurable business outcomes for both Autodesk and the customer.
This role is suited for an experienced enterprise sales leader who can operate with senior decision-makers, navigate complex customer organizations, lead matrixed teams, and create scalable growth opportunities across EBA and non-EBA enterprise accounts.

Strategic Account Growth
Lead and refine comprehensive growth strategies for assigned enterprise accounts, including EBA and non-EBA customers
Develop multi-year strategic account plans aligned to customer priorities, Autodesk growth objectives, and long-term value creation
Identify and pursue expansion opportunities across new business units, buyer groups, personas, and use cases
Drive buyer seat expansion and product adoption across complex customer organizations
Lead QBRs, executive check-ins, and senior stakeholder engagement to review progress, business outcomes, risks, and future growth opportunities
Innovate account strategies that create scalable growth models and influence broader business outcomes
Revenue Generation & Pipeline Management
Maximize incremental revenue through upsell, cross-sell, upgraded products, new offerings, and EBA token consumption strategies
Own pipeline development, pipeline health, and forecasting accuracy for growth, expansion, and renewal opportunities
Use data-driven insights to assess account potential, customer spend trends, adoption signals, whitespace, and risk
Proactively adjust account tactics based on customer priorities, market changes, competitive dynamics, and business goals
Deliver predictable revenue performance while identifying transformational opportunities that support long-term customer and Autodesk growth
Executive Relationship Management
Build and maintain strategic relationships with C-level executives, senior decision-makers, and key influencers across assigned accounts
Adapt communication style to diverse executive audiences and manage challenging conversations with confidence, empathy, and business relevance
Act as a trusted advisor by connecting Autodesk capabilities to the customer’s strategic objectives and transformation priorities
Develop compelling executive narratives that articulate business value, ROI, competitive differentiation, and long-term partnership opportunities
Secure and maintain executive sponsorship for strategic initiatives, commercial agreements, and expansion opportunities
Complex Deal Strategy & Commercial Execution
Lead complex enterprise negotiations, including expansions, renewals, multi-year agreements, and high-value commercial structures
Build value-based business cases that quantify customer impact and support executive decision-making
Navigate procurement, commercial, legal, and stakeholder complexity to progress opportunities and mitigate risk
Mentor teams in complex deal negotiations and help shape strategic deal approaches across large enterprise opportunities
Account Team Unit / Cross-Functional Orchestration
Strategically lead partnerships with the extended sales team, Technical Sales, Customer Success, Consulting, Marketing, Partner teams, and executive stakeholders
Orchestrate the Account Team Unit to co-develop scalable, impactful customer solutions
Align technical discovery, messaging, value proposition, and commercial strategy to customer needs
Drive accountability across internal teams through clear ownership, communication, and execution cadence
Ensure seamless post-sale handoff to Customer Success for onboarding, implementation, adoption, and ongoing relationship management
Serve as an escalation point for customer challenges and internal alignment issues
Partner with Customer Success and Consulting teams to ensure customers achieve measurable business outcomes from Autodesk solutions
Industry, Competitive & Business Leadership
Maintain deep knowledge of the customer’s industry, business model, transformation priorities, competitive landscape, and regulatory environment
Translate industry challenges into tailored Autodesk solutions and differentiated value propositions
Provide customer and market insights to internal Sales, Product, Strategy, and Marketing teams
Influence Autodesk’s go-to-market approach by sharing enterprise customer needs, competitive intelligence, and emerging market opportunities
Represent Autodesk as a strategic thought partner in executive-level customer conversations

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience
10+ years of enterprise sales, strategic account management, or consultative business development experience
Proven success managing complex enterprise accounts and driving significant revenue growth
Experience engaging C-level executives and senior stakeholders across large, matrixed customer organizations
Demonstrated ability to lead complex commercial negotiations, renewals, expansions, and multi-year enterprise agreements
Strong track record of pipeline generation, forecast accuracy, and revenue attainment
Experience leading cross-functional account teams, including Technical Sales, Customer Success, Consulting, Marketing, Partner, Legal, Finance, and Deal Desk stakeholders
Strong business acumen, analytical thinking, executive communication, and consultative selling skills

Experience in enterprise SaaS, cloud, platform, digital transformation, or technology solution sales
Familiarity with Autodesk’s Architecture, Engineering, and Construction customer segments and the business challenges, workflows, and digital transformation priorities within the AECO industry
Experience leading strategic customer transformations, large-scale adoption programs, or executive-sponsored growth initiatives
Advanced skills in value-based selling, ROI modeling, business case development, and executive storytelling
Experience using Salesforce or similar CRM and account planning tools
Experience mentoring account teams or influencing sales strategy beyond assigned accounts

Do you want the challenge — and the reward — of building your own book of business? At Keycafe , we’re looking for an Account Executive who thrives on creating new opportunities, closing deals, and owning an entire territory or industry segment.

This isn’t account management or order processing — it’s a chance to be entrepreneurial inside a growing SaaS/IoT company and essentially build a business of your own. What You’ll Do Own a market — you will be focused on the Australian market, and you’ll be responsible for growing our top segments as if it were your own business.

Run high-impact demos that clearly show prospects how our SmartBox product solves their operational challenges. Drive the full sales cycle: prospecting, outreach, demos, negotiation, and close. Experiment and adapt — try new outreach methods, refine your pitch, and find creative ways to break through.

Collaborate across teams to ensure smooth handoffs and long-term customer success. Why Join Keycafe Entrepreneurial ownership: AEs at Keycafe own entire industries or countries, giving you the chance to build your own business line inside the company.

Global impact: Our SmartBox is trusted by customers worldwide, from small businesses to large organizations. Startup culture with reach: Be part of a fast-growing SaaS/IoT company where your ideas matter and your success is highly visible.

About Keycafe Keycafe , headquartered in Vancouver and with a team spanning the globe, powers secure and seamless key management for businesses worldwide. Our SmartBox system combines IoT hardware with cloud software to give organizations total control over their keys — anytime, anywhere.

From hospitality and property management to logistics, fleets, and government, companies rely on Keycafe to keep operations secure, efficient, and scalable. Requirements Who You Are 2+ years of B2B SaaS or high-velocity sales experience with a track record of consistently closing new business.

A self-starter who’s energized by ownership — you don’t just run plays, you create them. Resilient and resourceful — you keep moving after rejection and find new ways to win. Passionate about learning products and showing customers how they can transform operations.

Startup-minded — flexible, collaborative, and willing to contribute beyond your immediate role. Nice to Have Sales experience in industries like hospitality, property management, fleet/logistics, facilities/security, first responder, or government services. Background in IoT, access control, or hardware-enabled SaaS.

Benefits Base salary $60,000 - $70,000 AUD plus uncapped commission, expected OTE $95,000 - $110,000 AUD. Remote-friendly with flexibility to own your territory or industry. Opportunity to build and grow your own business line within a scaling SaaS/IoT company. Work with a tangible, innovative product already trusted by businesses worldwide.

Career growth and visibility — your success is highly visible in a company where results matter. Originally posted on Himalayas

Summary The National Account Manager (NAM), Hyatt, Lifestyle Independent, and Casinos owns three premium-aligned segments for La Colombe: the Hyatt premium brand portfolio, the lifestyle independent hotel segment, and the casino enterprise segment. These buyers share a common premium mindset across hotels and entertainment.

The NAM is responsible for driving distribution, programming, and partnership growth across the corporate, brand, and property layers within these three segments.

Responsibilities Account Ownership — Hyatt, Lifestyle, and Casinos Own corporate procurement and senior Food & Beverage (F&B) relationships within Hyatt’s upper-upscale and luxury portfolio.

Manage lifestyle independent hotel groups at the corporate and brand level, including premium resorts, urban lifestyle properties, and luxury independent operators. Own casino enterprise relationships across leading regional gaming, destination resort, and integrated resort operators.

Develop relationships with destination resort operators, including mountain, family, and integrated resort groups, at the F&B leadership level. Identify high-value individual properties as proof-point accounts across assigned segments.

Strategic Planning and Programming Develop and execute named-account business plans focused on distribution growth, account programming, and trade investment. Drive product placement, beverage program penetration, and menu integration across assigned customer brands.

Build customized Joint Business Plans (JBPs) that align with customer objectives and create mutual value. Manage Request for Proposal (RFP) cycles, Group Purchasing Organization (GPO) approval pathways, and contract renewals, including per-serving cost modeling and competitive positioning.

Relationship Management Build strong relationships with key decision makers and stakeholders across corporate, brand, regional, and property levels. Negotiate contracts that drive execution and programming while maintaining appropriate trade spend levels.

Develop customized presentations using business insights to address customer needs and secure execution and programming wins. Lead business reviews and hold partners accountable to agreed-upon execution and program goals. Participate in relevant trade shows and industry conferences.

Cross-Functional Partnership Partner with field sales teams to support property-level execution across key accounts. Collaborate with service operations on equipment standards, installation pipelines, and preventive maintenance plans. Partner with channel marketing on co-op programs, customer-facing materials, and brand activations.

Coordinate with product and delivery system teams on on-tap product deployments where applicable. Reporting and Pipeline Discipline Maintain Customer Relationship Management (CRM) records following meaningful customer interactions. Provide consistent pipeline updates and forecasts to the Sr. Director, Hospitality.

Support Quarterly Business Review (QBR) and annual planning cycles through account-level revenue, margin, and program performance reporting. Requirements 7+ years of Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG) Away From Home (AFH) sales experience, with significant experience managing hotel, premium restaurant, or chain accounts at the national level.

Proven success managing complex buyer organizations, including corporate procurement, brand Food & Beverage (F&B) leadership, regional operations, and Group Purchasing Organization (GPO) relationships. Direct experience managing chain Request for Proposal (RFP) processes, contract negotiations, and per-serving cost modeling.

Strong understanding of the GPO landscape preferred. Self-motivated and entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to work independently in a remote environment. Strong analytical, presentation, relationship-building, and negotiation skills.

Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint; Customer Relationship Management (CRM) experience (HubSpot or equivalent) required. Prior experience selling into Hyatt premium, lifestyle independent hotels, or casino enterprise Food & Beverage programs strongly preferred.

Ability to build relationships across both corporate procurement organizations and high-touch ownership groups. EDUCATION Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree a plus. TRAVEL 30–50% travel — primarily to customer headquarters and leading premium properties.

About Us Chobani is a food maker with a mission of making high-quality and nutritious food accessible to more people, while elevating our communities and making the world a healthier place. In short: making good food for all.

In support of this mission, Chobani is a purpose-driven, people-first, food-and-wellness-focused company, and has been since its founding in 2005 by Hamdi Ulukaya, an immigrant to the U.S.

The Company manufactures yogurt, oat milk, and creamers – Chobani yogurt is America's No.1 yogurt brand, made with natural ingredients without artificial preservatives.

Following the 2023 acquisition of La Colombe, a leading coffee roaster with a shared commitment to quality, craftmanship and impact, the Company began selling cold-pressed espresso and lattes on tap at cafés nationwide, as well as Ready to Drink (RTD) coffee beverages at retail.

In 2025, Chobani acquired Daily Harvest, a modern brand offering consumers nutritious, delicious and convenient ready-to-make meals. Chobani uses food as a force for good in the world – putting humanity first in everything it does. The company's philanthropic efforts prioritize giving back to its communities and beyond.

Chobani manufactures its products in New York, Idaho, Michigan and Australia, and its products are available throughout North America and distributed in Australia and other select markets. For more information, please visit  www.chobani.com or follow us on Facebook, Twitter, Instagram and LinkedIn. Chobani is an equal opportunity employer.

Chobani will not discriminate against any applicant for employment on any basis including, but not limited to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, military and/or veteran status, marital status, predisposing genetic characteristics and genetic information, or any other classification protected by federal, state, and local laws.

The salary range for this full-time position is $123,300.00 - $150,700.00, + bonus + equity + benefits. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for your preferred location during the hiring process. Chobani provides a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision coverage, disability insurance, health savings account, flexible spending accounts, and tuition reimbursement.

To help save for the future, all employees are eligible for a 401k match of 100% on up to 5% of eligible pay. To support growing families, we provide fertility and childcare assistance, and 12 weeks of parental leave at full pay after six months of continuous employment.

In addition, we provide wellness resources which include an employee assistance program, fitness discounts, a wellness reimbursement, on-site gym access (certain locations) and a monthly wellness newsletter to connect you with resources and timely information.

We offer various types of paid time of including: 120 hours of paid time off, 11 holidays, and paid volunteer time off. Originally posted on Himalayas

The AI-powered OS for beauty, wellness and self-care About Fresha Fresha is the AI-powered operating system for the global beauty, wellness and self-care industry, connecting and powering everything from salons and barbers to spas, medspas, fitness studios and health practices. Trusted by millions of consumers and businesses worldwide.

Fresha is used by 140,000+ businesses and 450,000+ stylists and professionals worldwide, processing over 1 billion appointments to date. The company is headquartered in London, United Kingdom, with 15 global offices located across North America, EMEA and APAC.

Fresha allows consumers to discover, book and pay for beauty and wellness appointments with local businesses via its marketplace, while beauty and wellness businesses and professionals use an all-in-one platform to manage their entire operations with an intuitive business software and financial technology solutions.

Fresha ’s ecosystem gives merchants everything they need to run their business seamlessly by facilitating appointment bookings, point-of-sale, customer records management, marketing automation, loyalty, beauty products inventory and team management.

The consumer marketplace unlocks revenue potential for partner businesses by leveraging the power of online bookings and automated marketing through mobile apps and advanced integrations with major tech brands including Instagram, Facebook and Google.

Role Overview Given our exciting and progressive growth plans, we are looking for an exceptional Business Development Executive to join our global business.

Reporting directly to the General Manager of Southern Europe and working collaboratively with the Commercial team and strategic partners, you will be 100% focused on driving new business growth and expanding Fresha 's presence across the region.

This is a remote role, offering the opportunity to take ownership of a high-growth territory while helping to accelerate Fresha 's expansion.

You will be responsible for identifying, prospecting, and engaging beauty and wellness businesses in your region, combining proactive field sales activity with a consultative approach to build strong local relationships and drive commercial success.

This is a great opportunity for someone who thrives in a fast-paced and evolving environment, enjoys working autonomously, embraces challenges, and wants to make a tangible impact on the growth of a leading global technology platform.

What you will be doing KPIs - Consistently achieve sales targets Outreach - Calling key decision-makers using phone, email & social touches with the goal of bringing on new business (in-person meetings as appropriate) Selling - Present, promote and sell products and services through product demos to prospective and existing partners Sales Cycle - Managing the entire sales process from prospecting to close Partnering - Perform cost-benefit and needs analysis with existing/potential partners in order to align our solutions to their needs and business objectives Collaboration - Work closely with other departments to ensure a seamless partner experience Market Trends - Provide feedback about ongoing trends in the industry Leads - Contact 100% of qualified inbound leads in a timely manner, and document all call outcomes in the CRM Business Partnering - Serve as a lead point of contact for partners on all commercial activities This list is not exhaustive and there may be other activities you are required to deliver.

What we are looking for Experience - Minimum 1 years of solid B2B sales with a track record of success Industry - SaaS, online marketplaces, or payment platforms is highly desirable Relationship Building - You are a true hunter and relationship builder Organised - You can multitask, prioritise and manage time effectively Curiosity - You are naturally curious and have a desire to continually grow and develop Added bonus Bi-lingual - Fluency in Spanish and another language - preferably Basque Beauty & Wellness - Experience within the beauty and wellness industry At Fresha , we value passion and potential as much as specific skills.

If you're enthusiastic and eager to learn, we encourage you to apply, even if you don't meet every listed requirement. We believe in fostering growth and providing the support needed for you to excel in your role.

Interview process Screening Call - Video-call with a member from the Talent Team (30 mins) 1st Stage - Video interview with Team Lead (45 mins) Final Stage + Presentation - Video interview with Team Lead and General Manager (Europe) (75 mins) We aim to finalise the entire interview process and deliver feedback within 2 weeks.

Every job application received is reviewed manually by our talent team. While we strive to assess applications within 7 days, the sheer volume of talented individuals expressing interest may occasionally extend this timeframe. Inclusive workforce At Fresha , we are creating a culture where individuals of all backgrounds feel comfortable.

We want all Fresha people to feel included and truly empowered to contribute fully to our vision and goals. Everyone who applies will receive fair consideration for employment.

We do not discriminate based on race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, marital status, gender identity, national origin, disability, or any other applicable legally protected characteristics in the location in which the candidate is applying.

If you have any accessibility requirements that would make you more comfortable during the interview process and/or once you join, please let us know so that we can support you. Originally posted on Himalayas

Our clients include startups, digital agencies, and tech platforms in industries such as SaaS, MarTech, FinTech, and EdTech. Unlike an outsourcing agency, we place you directly with a client where you’re hired in-house as a valued member of their team.

We are hiring a results-drivenAccount Executiveto join one of our international client teams. In this role, you will own the full sales cycle — from conducting discovery calls and product demos to negotiating contracts and closing deals.
This opportunity is ideal for experienced sales professionals with strong consultative selling skills who are confident managing pipeline, forecasting revenue, and consistently hitting targets.

Manage the full sales cycle from qualified lead to closed deal

Collaborate with SDRs/BDRs and marketing teams to improve lead quality

2–5+ years of experience in B2B sales or closing roles

Experience managing pipeline and forecasting revenue
Proficiency with CRM systems and sales engagement tools
Excellent English communication skills (verbal and written)
Professional remote work setup with reliable internet

Experience in SaaS, tech, digital marketing, or subscription-based businesses
Experience selling to international markets (UK, US, Canada, Australia)
Familiarity with complex sales cycles and mid-to-high ticket deals

With powerful AI Agents embedded across our platform, teams can analyze, test, and optimize user experiences faster than ever. Ranked #1 across multiple categories in G2’s Winter 2026 Report, Amplitude is the best-in-class solution for product, data, and marketing teams. Learn more at amplitude.com .
As an organization, we deliver for our customers by living our values. We operate from a place of humility, take ownership of problems and successes, approach challenges with a growth mindset, and put our customers at the center of everything we do.
Amplitude’s Commitment to Diversity Equity & Inclusion (DEI): Amplitude believes that diversity enables the creation of better products, improves the ability to solve complex problems, and drives more powerful solutions. We strive to create an environment of inclusion—one focused on psychological safety, empathy, and human connection—that will allow employees of all backgrounds to thrive.
Amplitude is an AI Native digital analytics platform that helps companies capture data they can trust, uncover clear insights about customer behaviour, and take action fast. This empowers product, data, marketing, and business teams to build better digital experiences and drive sustainable growth.
We’re proud to be recognized as the #1 product analytics solution on G2 , #1 leader in Forrester Wave Analytics solutions and one of the best software products in the world , as well as a top tech company to bet your career on according to Business Insider and one of Fast Company’s most innovative enterprise companies.

The DACH region is a Tier 1 strategic market for Amplitude in EMEA with a large, underpenetrated enterprise customer base and significant greenfield opportunity. We're now looking to accelerate our next phase of growth with a senior, market-building Enterprise Account Executive with a clear path to leadership.

s.h: As a Senior Enterprise Account Executive, DACH , you will
s.t:
Own a highly targeted Enterprise territory across Germany, Austria, and Switzerland, focusing on new business lands - whilst supporting and expanding an existing enterprise customer base. You are responsible for end-to-end ownership of the customer.
Be the builder and hunter who turns Europe's largest economy into Amplitude's largest region in EMEA.
Act as a natural leader in the field: you’ll join as an individual contributor with a clear, performance-based path toward team leadership as we continue to scale the region.
You’ll be part of a seasoned, high performing international GTM team in Northern Europe, working across the DACH, Nordics & Benelux markets.
Have 5-10 years Saas sales experience with at least 3 of those working with Enterprise accounts

Build and own your DACH enterprise territory strategy
Develop and execute a territory plan across a focused list of major enterprise and large accounts. Prioritise where to focus your teams time and how to win, driving net‑new logo acquisition with strategic expansion in a small set of high-potential existing customers.
Drive new business in a largely under-penetrated market
Generate pipeline through a mix of outbound prospecting, partner collaboration, events, and your own network. You’ll educate the market on digital analytics and Amplitude’s differentiated approach rather than stepping into a fully warmed territory.
Run complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles
Own the full sales process from discovery and value definition through business case, procurement, and executive sponsorship. Navigate multiple senior stakeholders (C‑level, Product, Data, Marketing, Engineering) and align them around a clear vision for product-led growth with Amplitude.
Sell strategically and predictably
Use structured methodologies (e.g., Value Selling, MEDD(P)ICC) for qualification, mutual action planning, and rigorous pipeline management. Accurately forecast and manage an enterprise book of 6–9 month enterprise sales cycles with deal values in the mid‑five to six-figure ARR range and growing.
Orchestrate the broader Amplitude team
Work hand‑in‑hand with Solutions Engineers, Customer Success, Marketing,Partners, internal executive stakeholders to run high-quality, complex evaluations, POCs, and EBCs/EBR's that tie Amplitude to measurable business outcomes for customers.
Act as a visible market builder for Amplitude in DACH
Represent Amplitude at regional events, product management and data community meetups, and with key technology and agency partners to drive awareness and category education in the DACH market.
Lead by example and help shape the future team
Set the bar for enterprise selling excellence in DACH. Share best practices, mentor newer reps, and help define what “great” looks like for the next generation of Enterprise AEs and potential future team members.
Exceed quota and build the business: Consistently deliver against quarterly and annual new business and expansion targets, while laying the groundwork for long‑term growth in your territory.
By applying for this job, you acknowledge that Amplitude processes your personal data in accordance with the Amplitude Applicant Privacy Notice .
Staying Safe - Protect Yourself From Recruitment Fraud
We are aware of individuals and entities fraudulently representing themselves as Amplitude recruiters and/or hiring managers. Amplitude will never ask for financial information or payment, or for personal information such as bank account number or social security number during the job application or interview process.

Any emails from the Amplitude recruiting team will come from an @ amplitude.com email address. You can learn more about how to protect yourself from these types of fraud by referring to this article . Please exercise caution and cease communications if something feels suspicious about your interactions.

Die AdWise Media GmbH ist spezialisiert auf innovative Werbeflächen direkt am Point of Sale. Mit unserer Kassenbandwerbung bringen wir regionale Unternehmen genau dorthin, wo täglich tausende potenzielle Kunden erreicht werden – direkt an die Supermarktkasse.
Für unseren Standort in Bonn suchen wir einen erfahrenen und ambitionierten Vertriebsleiter:in / Head of Sales (m/w/d) , der Verantwortung für unser Vertriebsteam übernimmt und gemeinsam mit der Geschäftsführung unseren Vertrieb auf das nächste Level bringt.
Bei uns erwartet dich kein Konzern mit langen Entscheidungswegen, sondern ein wachsendes Unternehmen mit kurzen Wegen, viel Verantwortung und echtem Gestaltungsspielraum.
Aufgaben
Als Vertriebsleiter übernimmst du die Verantwortung für die Performance unseres Vertriebsteams – und bleibst gleichzeitig selbst aktiv im Verkauf.

Führung, Coaching und Weiterentwicklung unseres Vertriebsteam
Eigenständiges Führen von Verkaufsgesprächen und Abschluss von Neukund
Verantwortung für einen eigenen monatlichen Umsatz als Closer
Übernahme qualifizierter und bereits terminierter Verkaufsgespräch
Verantwortung für die Erreichung der individuellen und teamweiten Umsatzziel
Steuerung unserer Setter und Closer anhand klar definierter KPI
Regelmäßige Analyse von Calls und gezieltes Coaching der Vertriebsmitarbeite
Durchführung von Sales-Meetings, 1:1s und Performance Review
Analyse von Terminquote, Show-Rate, Closing-Rate, Durchschnittsumsatz und weiteren Sales-KPI
Optimierung des gesamten Vertriebsprozesses vom Erstkontakt bis zum Vertragsabschlus
Weiterentwicklung von Sales-Skripten, Einwandbehandlung und Closing-Strategie
Sicherstellung einer sauberen CRM-Pipeline sowie verlässlicher Forecast
Recruiting, Onboarding und Einarbeitung neuer Vertriebsmitarbeiter
Enge Zusammenarbeit mit der Geschäftsführung bei Vertriebsstrategie und Skalierung
Nutzung und Weiterentwicklung von KI- und Automatisierungslösungen im Vertrieb
Die Position ist ausdrücklich als Playing-Coach-Rolle gedacht: Du führst das Team, entwickelst unsere Vertriebsstrukturen weiter und gehst gleichzeitig selbst als Vorbild in Verkaufsgespräche. Wir suchen keinen reinen Sales Manager, sondern jemanden, der Führung und operativen Vertrieb miteinander verbindet.
Qualifikation
Du passt zu uns, wenn du bereits nachweislich erfolgreich im B2B-Vertrieb abgeschlossen hast und jetzt zusätzlich Verantwortung für ein Vertriebsteam übernehmen möchtest.

Mehrjährige Erfahrung im B2B-Vertrieb
Nachweisbare Erfolge im telefonischen bzw. digitalen Closing

Senior Account Executive — West Coast (Remote, US)
About emnify
emnify is a leading cloud-native IoT connectivity provider helping businesses connect and manage devices globally through a single, modern platform. Our technology powers connected products across industries including mobility, logistics, energy, healthcare, and security — enabling enterprises to scale IoT faster, more securely, and with greater flexibility.
Built for the cloud era, emnify combines global cellular connectivity, network intelligence, and seamless API integrations into one platform that simplifies how businesses deploy and manage connected devices worldwide.
With strong international growth and increasing momentum in the U.S. market, emnify is helping redefine what modern IoT connectivity looks like.
---

This is a remote role covering the West Coast territory, sitting within a US sales team of around ten people and reporting directly to the VP of Sales, North America. You will own the full sales cycle — from prospecting and qualification through to close — for new enterprise accounts in your territory. You will work closely with Solutions Engineering, Product Management, Marketing, and Legal to bring the right resources to bear at the right moments in each deal.
Why emnify
IoT connectivity is moving from fragmented, carrier-dependent infrastructure toward cloud-native platforms — and emnify is at the front of that shift. The US market is a genuine growth priority, not an afterthought, and this territory represents real, buildable opportunity.

You will be selling a product with strong technical differentiation into a buyer community that is actively looking for a better answer than what legacy telcos offer. The deals are complex and meaningful, the internal team is lean and collaborative, and the company has hit a series of significant milestones that signal strong commercial momentum.

If you want a role where your territory performance is visible and your contribution matters, this is it.

Drive new enterprise revenue across the West Coast territory, owning every stage of the sales cycle from first contact to signed contract
Build a disciplined, data-driven pipeline using a structured qualification framework and rigorous CRM hygiene, so your forecast is reliable and your activity is repeatable
Own commercial negotiations — pricing, competitive positioning, business case development, and contracting — coordinating internal stakeholders to move deals forward
Develop trusted relationships with decision-makers and influencers across Line of Business Management, Product, Operations, and Procurement within target accounts
Establish a sustainable territory strategy: a clear account prioritisation plan, consistent prospecting motion, and a pipeline that covers future quota periods, not just the current quarter
What We Expect
A proven track record of closing complex B2B SaaS or technology deals at the enterprise level, with consistent quota attainment
Experience managing and closing deals with ARR above $100k, including navigating multi-stakeholder buying processes and extended sales cycles
Fluency in a structured sales methodology — MEDDIC, Challenger, SPIN, or similar — and the discipline to apply it consistently rather than selectively
Comfort operating in a value-based selling motion: you build business cases, you quantify ROI, and you sell outcomes rather than features
Proficiency with CRM and sales tools (Salesforce, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, or equivalents) and a genuine preference for a data-driven approach to managing your territory
Clear, confident written and verbal communication — you can adapt your message for a technical buyer, a procurement lead, or a C-suite sponsor
Coachability — we want someone who is excited to grow with us
Your First 6 Months
In your first few weeks , the priority is depth over activity. You will complete onboarding, work through product and technical training, and develop a solid grasp of emnify's ideal customer profile, buyer personas, pricing model, and competitive positioning.
By month two or three , you will be prospecting independently — running outbound alongside inbound follow-up, conducting your own discovery calls, and qualifying opportunities against emnify's framework. You will start building pipeline and learning which messages and objections resonate with our buyers. Expect to be generating meetings and managing early-stage opportunities with increasing independence.
By the halfway mark , you should own a live set of opportunities at multiple stages of the funnel. You will be running complete discovery and demo cycles, coordinating Solutions Engineering and other internal resources, producing a reliable forecast, and progressing late-stage deals toward close. Depending on sales-cycle length, this is when first wins typically become possible.
The broader arc is becoming a repeatable, forecastable contributor — someone with a clear territory strategy, consistent prospecting habits, strong internal relationships, and a sharp understanding of why deals are won or lost.
Why It Might Not Be a Match
If you prefer a highly structured, process-heavy environment with clearly defined playbooks at every step, you may find emnify's pace and degree of self-direction uncomfortable — we are still building, and we expect this person to help shape how things are done, not just follow an established script
If you are most comfortable managing a high volume of smaller, transactional deals, the complexity and longer timelines of enterprise IoT sales cycles may not suit your natural rhythm
If you need a large, well-resourced support organisation around you before you feel confident going to market, this role will feel underpowered — the team is lean, which means high ownership and real impact, but also real ambiguity

About WorkWhile
WorkWhile is on a mission to help workers earn a better living and live better lives. 83 million Americans work hourly jobs: the true backbone of the hospitality, catering, and event industries. These workers often face highly volatile schedules, sudden booking surges, minimum wage pay, and limited benefits, leading to financial instability.
WorkWhile identifies the best, most reliable hourly workers and matches them with shifts that fit their skills, location, and life.

For high-volume catering companies, stadium and venue operators, corporate food service providers, and large-scale event producers, we provide instant access to a vetted, high-quality workforce to seamlessly scale up for major events and peak periods.

For workers, we provide stable income and unmatched benefits, including next-day pay, free telehealth services, upskilling, and financial wellness tools.
We have the audacious goal to align incentives and solve inefficiencies in the labor market, disrupting the $650 billion staffing and recruiting market. Backed by Khosla Ventures and recognized by the Inc. 5000 for 10x growth, WorkWhile is reshaping the future of work in hospitality and live events.

WorkWhile is looking for an Enterprise Account Manager - Hospitality to join our team and build long-term, trusting relationships with our enterprise hospitality and event clients.

This role is focused on managing a portfolio of high-volume accounts, including catering conglomerates, national contract food service providers, sports and entertainment venue operators, and premier event management groups, ensuring they have the right workforce to keep operations running smoothly, especially during peak seasons, major event rollouts, and sudden booking surges.
You will serve as the primary point of contact for hospitality enterprise accounts, driving satisfaction, retention, and growth while acting as a strategic partner who understands the fast-paced, high-stakes nature of food service, catering, and venue management.

Lead Account Relationship: Serve as the lead point of contact for all account management matters for enterprise hospitality and event clients, including staffing planning, shift fulfillment, and ongoing labor strategy.
Build Executive & Regional Alignment: Build and maintain strong, long-lasting relationships with regional event/culinary directors, general managers, corporate food service directors, venue concessionaires, and VP-level operations leaders.
Understand Industry Dynamics: Develop a deep understanding of each client’s operational environment, including hyper-seasonal staffing volatility, last-minute event bookings/cancellations, variable labor costs, and guest service standards, to proactively meet their workforce needs.
Drive Contract Growth & Retention: Maintain and grow client accounts, identifying upsell and expansion opportunities across regional event sites, venue networks, multi-unit properties, or new culinary/hospitality labor categories.
Act as a Trusted Advisor: Develop trusted advisor relationships with key hospitality accounts, aligning WorkWhile's workforce solutions to their operational goals, ROI targets, and guest experience standards.
Ensure Operational Excellence: Ensure timely and successful fulfillment of shifts in line with strict client SLAs, worker reliability metrics, and service quality expectations for high-profile events.
Transparent Stakeholder Communication: Communicate the progress of weekly, monthly, and quarterly workforce initiatives clearly to both internal operations teams and enterprise client executives.
Track & Forecast Metrics: Forecast and track key account metrics including fill rates, worker attendance/performance, client satisfaction scores, and revenue retention and expansion.
Deliver Business Reviews: Prepare regular account health reports and quarterly business reviews tailored to venue operators, contract food service executives, and catering leadership teams.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with the Sales team to expand WorkWhile's presence across new venue networks or regional operator groups, and collaborate with internal Operations teams to ensure fulfillment during peak periods (e.g., stadium game days, peak catering seasons, major conferences).
Issue Escalation & Resolution: Assist with challenging client requests or live-event operational escalations, providing quick and effective resolutions to minimize disruption to the guest experience.

Experience: 3+ years experience as an Account Manager, ideally within the contract food service, event management, catering, venue operations, or flexible workforce solutions industries.
Deep Hospitality & Event IQ: A profound understanding of the logistics behind large-scale catering, stadium operations, corporate dining, and how workforce reliability directly impacts guest experience and margin.
Executive Presence & Influence: Demonstrated ability to communicate, present, and influence stakeholders at all levels, from regional culinary directors and venue GMs to VP-level hospitality executives.
Multi-Unit Expertise: Experience managing multi-unit, enterprise-scale hospitality accounts, venue networks, or multi-city event portfolios.
Tech Stack Proficiency: Solid experience with CRM software (Salesforce or similar) and Google Suite.
Track Record of Growth: Proven track record of delivering client-focused labor solutions, maintaining high customer retention rates, and hitting revenue growth/expansion targets.
Agility & Attention to Detail: Ability to juggle multiple complex enterprise accounts and fast-moving event timelines while maintaining sharp attention to detail.
Communication Skills: Excellent listening, negotiation, presentation, verbal, and written communication skills.

5+ years of commercial experience in e-commerce, retail media, food-delivery marketplaces, or high-growth B2B sales environments.

Fluency in Polish and English (written and spoken).
Proficiency in commercial data analysis , including advanced Excel skills, with a demonstrated ability to turn metrics into persuasive sales narratives.

Customer Centricity: Strong emotional intelligence and communication skills, with an innate ability to adjust your style to connect with and influence C-level stakeholders.

Meet DeepL
DeepL is a global AI product and research company focused on building secure, intelligent solutions to complex business problems. Over 200,000 business customers and millions of individuals across 228 global markets today trust DeepL's Language AI platform for human-like translation, improved writing and real-time voice translation.
Founded in 2017 by CEO Jaroslaw “Jarek” Kutylowski, DeepL now has around 1,000 passionate employees and is supported by world-renowned investors including Benchmark, IVP, and Index Ventures.
Our goal is to become the global leader in trusted, intelligent AI technology, building products that drive better communication, foster connections, and create a meaningful impact. To achieve this, we need talented people like you to join our journey. If you’re ready to shape the future of AI and grow your career in a fast-moving, purpose-driven environment, DeepL is your next destination.
What sets us apart
What sets us apart is our blend of cutting-edge AI technology, meaningful work, and a culture where people truly thrive. We’re a team of innovators, researchers, and creators driven by a shared purpose to unlock human potential by making work simpler, smarter, and more connected.
When we share what it’s like to work at DeepL, the reactions are overwhelmingly positive. This might be because of our technology that helps millions of people and businesses communicate and work better every day, or because of the trust, curiosity, and care that shape our culture.
What we know for sure is this: being part of DeepL means joining a team dedicated to innovation, growth, and well-being. Discover more about life at DeepL on LinkedIn , Instagram , and our Blog .

s.h: Meet the team behind this journey
s.t:
At DeepL, we're on an exciting adventure to expand our operations to match our ambitious growth plans. At the heart of this journey is our Sales team, a cornerstone of DeepL's market expansion and customer engagement strategy.
Our mission is clear: to build and develop high-performing sales teams that embody DeepL's innovative spirit and commitment to excellence. As a member of our Sales team, you will play a central role in growing our business and expanding our global reach into new markets. Working in close partnership with Marketing, Product, and Customer Success teams, you will collaborate to deliver tailored solutions that genuinely meet our clients' needs.
About this opportunity
We are looking for an exceptional sales professional based in Austria (preferable) OR Switzerland to establish and grow DeepL's presence in the Austrian market. This is a rare opportunity to build something meaningful in a market where we're just getting started.

You will be a key player in our Austrian expansion, bringing together an entrepreneurial approach with deep market knowledge — and you won't be doing it alone. You'll have the full support of an experienced, collaborative international team behind you.

Shape our Austrian market entry: You will be at the forefront of DeepL's expansion into Austria, introducing our market-leading translation services to clients and helping them break down language barriers
Build with purpose: Establish our sales foundation in Austria — creating processes, relationships, and market presence where little currently exists
Become a trusted market expert: Develop deep knowledge of the Austrian business landscape, cultural nuances, and customer needs to position DeepL as a valued and trusted solution
Represent and advocate: Serve as an expert on DeepL's products and your customers' needs, troubleshooting thoughtfully and resolving inquiries with care
Own the full sales cycle: As a trusted partner to new and incoming customers, you will qualify and convert leads and guide opportunities from first contact to close
Set and reach meaningful goals: Work towards monthly activity, pipeline, and revenue goals as we establish our presence in the market together
Cultivate a strong pipeline: Identify and develop new business opportunities, including upselling and cross-selling where it adds real value for clients
Manage diverse opportunities: Respond to inbound prospects and customers, navigating a varied mix of opportunities from qualification through to close
Stay organised and forward-looking: Track opportunity and customer details including use cases, timelines, and next steps to keep things moving smoothly
Connect across teams: Work closely with our diverse, international, and welcoming teams — from SDRs to Marketing — collaborating across borders with openness and curiosity
Qualities we look for
We know that confidence gaps and imposter syndrome can sometimes hold people back from applying. If you're excited about this role and feel you have most of what we're looking for, we'd genuinely love to hear from you — even if you don't tick every box.
Entrepreneurial mindset: You enjoy building from the ground up and feel energised by the challenge of creating something new. You're comfortable with ambiguity and motivated by the opportunity to make a real impact
Deep Austrian market knowledge: You have genuine knowledge and appreciation of Austrian business culture, market dynamics, and customer preferences — and you understand what makes the market unique
Cultural fluency: You connect authentically with Austrian clients and partners, and bring a genuine appreciation for local values and business practices
Solid full-cycle sales experience: A proven track record in Enterprise Sales with the ability to manage complex, multi-stakeholder deals
SaaS expertise: Experience in software sales — especially SaaS — is preferred
Strong communication skills: Excellent organisation, presentation, and communication skills (verbal and written) across multicultural contexts
Adaptability and resilience: You feel comfortable in a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment and can shift priorities while maintaining momentum
Collaborative spirit: You thrive when working as part of a team, enjoy supporting colleagues, and value cross-functional collaboration
Language proficiency: Fluent in both, German and English

Diverse and internationally distributed team : joining our team means becoming part of a large, global community with people of more than 90 nationalities. We're more than just colleagues; we're a group of professionals with a shared mission to connect diverse cultures. Our global presence is growing–we've doubled in size nearly every year, with our employees based in the UK, Germany, the Netherlands, Poland, the US, and Japan, and we continue to expand our network.
Open communication, regular feedback : as a language-focused company, we value the importance of clear, honest communication. We value smooth collaboration, direct and actionable feedback, and believe that leading with empathy and growth mindset makes us better together.
Remote work, flexible hours : we offer a remote work schedule for Austria , enjoying the flexibility and comfort of working from home. With flexible working hours and trust in your productivity, we are in sync with your team's general locations and time zones to foster effective and seamless collaboration.

About SINGU
At SINGU , we’re redefining how the world’s most ambitious real estate companies run their operations. Our mission is to become Europe’s leading platform for managing warehouse, logistics, retail, and multi-site commercial real estate portfolios — empowering our Clients to protect revenue, boost efficiency, and unlock new value across every aspect of their business.
Our unified CAFM platform already powers the daily operations of over 250 million m² of real estate worldwide , supporting more than 500,000 professionals. Following our union with the UK’s Micad and Germany’s net-haus, we now help manage 100,000+ buildings across 35+ countries — and we’re just getting started.
Backed by a leading growth equity investor, we’re scaling rapidly and partnering with global leaders such as Prologis, ECE, CTP, Hillwood, Logicor, GLP, and Unibail-Rodamco-Westfield. As we continue to grow through strategic acquisitions and bold innovation, we stay true to our core values: adaptability, collaboration, and client focus.
If you’re ready to help build Europe’s leading platform for property operations — and make a tangible impact on how the real estate industry works — join SINGU and be part of this transformation.
The Opportunity
This is a pure new business role. You own a defined territory and named-account set, the pipeline you create within it, and the commercial outcome of every deal you run, from first conversation to signature.
The deals are consequential rather than transactional: multi-stakeholder, multi-site, six to nine months, with typical initial values of £25k- £100k and clear multi-country expansion potential. Winning takes a business case, not a demonstration and it requires strong discovery, quantified value, access to senior decision-makers and the ability to align stakeholders across operations, real estate, procurement, IT and finance.
Singu supports complex property and facilities operations across more than 250 million square metres, with established customers spanning commercial real estate, logistics, retail, facility management and the public sector. You will enter deals with credible enterprise references, a proven product and senior executive support, not an unproven proposition.
Why Strong Sellers Join Singu
A defined territory and named-account set, not an undifferentiated geographic patch.
Enterprise deals with meaningful initial value and clear multi-country expansion potential.
Dedicated business development, Pre-Sales, marketing and executive sponsorship.
Direct access to the CRO for deal strategy, coaching and fast commercial decisions. Pricing, terms and sponsorship all take place without a committee.
Uncapped earnings with meaningful accelerators for over-performance.
Credible routes into strategic or global accounts or sales leadership.
What You Will Own
Pipeline and Coverage
A new business quota, and a territory plan that shows how you intend to hit it.
Pipeline built through business development, marketing, partner and self-generated activity, with personal responsibility for coverage across the territory.
Diagnostic conversations grounded in operating cost, compliance and risk.
Deal Execution
Opportunities qualified to a MEDDICC standard, with a quantified business case and access to the economic buyer.
Every material deal multi-threaded, so it survives a change of sponsor.
Commercial negotiation that builds value and protects price rather than defaulting to discount.
Rigorous qualification and early decisions on opportunities that lack a credible business case, buying process or route to decision.
Land and Expand
First wins scoped so they can grow: sites, countries and use cases sequenced from the start.
A clean handover to Customer Success, with the expansion path documented.
Forecasting and Governance
A forecast that holds, with stage integrity, next steps and close dates you stand behind.
Risk surfaced early, with an honest view of what changed and what is needed.
Contribution to the playbook i.e. objections, competitive intelligence and repeatable use cases.
What Excellent Performance Looks Like
Commercial outcomes
New-logo ARR against quota
Pipeline creation and territory coverage
Win rate, against incumbents and against no decision
Average deal value and total multi-year value
Strategic logos won
Operating standards
Forecast accuracy and stage integrity
Multi-threading and MEDDICC quality
Price protection and discount discipline
CRM quality and process discipline
Your First 12 Months
First 90 days: complete onboarding, build the territory and account plan, establish pipeline coverage and create the first qualified opportunities.
By six months: credible coverage against ramped quota, multi-threaded opportunities progressing through evaluation, and a first customer win closed or materially advanced.
By 12 months: delivery against ramped quota, a repeatable pipeline-creation motion in your territory, and accounts landed with clear expansion potential.

Typically five or more years in B2B software or complex technology sales, including a sustained period carrying a new business quota. Quality of results matters more than years.
Evidence of sustained over-performance in new business sales: quota attainment, team ranking, pipeline personally created and representative deals won. We will ask for specifics.
The ability to take us through significant deals end to end: how the opportunity was created, how the buying group developed, what changed, and why it was won or lost.
English and German languages at business level. Hard requirement.
A structured seller: MEDDICC or comparable, used in practice.
Strong results combined with the forecast and CRM discipline to run a predictable business.
CAFM, IWMS, FM, PropTech or multi-site operations experience is an advantage.
Package, Support and Progression
Competitive base salary uncapped commission, accelerators for over-performance.
Business development coverage, Pre-Sales, marketing and enablement to support your success
Structured onboarding, methodology training and deal coaching, with a fairly ramped quota.
Progression into a global accounts or sales leadership. We back elite individual contributors as readily as future managers.
This role is for an accomplished new business seller who wants the autonomy to build a territory, the support to win complex enterprise deals and real reward for over-performance. If you have created pipeline, won meaningful customers and run a disciplined process, we would like to hear from you.
If this role sounds like a good fit, we’d love to hear from you. Apply and help us build technology that supports critical operations every day.

Our AI agent workforce helps the fastest-growing construction companies navigate everything from permitting and licensing to inspections and project closeouts – accelerating housing, clean-energy, and infrastructure development across the country.
Despite being a $1.6T industry, construction still suffers from massive delays, wasted capital, and lost opportunity. PermitFlow has already delivered unprecedented speed, accuracy, and visibility to over $20B in development, helping contractors reduce compliance time, de-risk projects, and scale with confidence.
As the U.S. enters a new capex supercycle across data centers, factories, housing, and renewables, joining PermitFlow means building the AI infrastructure at the core of every construction project driving the next wave of reindustrialization.
We’ve raised over $90M, most recently completing our Series B, from top-tier investors including Accel, Kleiner Perkins, Initialized, Y Combinator, Felicis, and Altos Ventures, with backing from leaders at OpenAI, Google, Procore, ServiceTitan, Zillow, PlanGrid, and Uber.

Own revenue, forecasting, and day-to-day execution for your team of enterprise Account Executives and assigned accounts, leveraging data to inform tactics
Report to the Enterprise Sales Director and help execute the segment-wide strategy with a consistent, repeatable enterprise motion
Recruit, lead, coach, and develop your team of enterprise Account Executives — driving performance management, career development, and a high-accountability, high-trust culture
Help refine and reinforce repeatable, scalable sales processes that standardize PermitFlow 's enterprise motion
Lead and coach the team through complex, multi-threaded deals with executives, operators, and procurement across multiple business units and PE roll-up accounts
Drive both net-new logo acquisition and expansion within existing roll-up and national accounts, converting pilots into multi-division, enterprise-wide partnerships
Partner cross-functionally (Solutions, CS, Product, Marketing, SDR, RevOps) to scope solutions, align the sales process with customer success, and ensure successful outcomes
Build and review ROI-driven business cases that resonate with C-suite and board-level stakeholders
Maintain forecasting accuracy, pipeline hygiene, and deal visibility across long enterprise sales cycles
Surface field and customer insights to the Enterprise Sales Director and GTM leadership to inform the enterprise roadmap and go-to-market strategy

Account Manager - Essex
Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation, and growth drives everything we do. Our Commercial team sits at the centre of Deliveroo’s marketplace—shaping how we serve restaurants, grocers, and new verticals worldwide.

From negotiating key partnerships to unlocking new revenue streams and crafting data-led growth strategies, we take on big challenges that move the business forward. If you thrive in fast-paced, commercial environments and want to influence the future of a global brand—this is the team for you.
We’re looking for an Account Manager to join our London team. This is a hybrid role. In this role, you’ll be a critical partner to the South of England’s most highly regarded restaurants, cultivating relationships to help them scale their online sales.
Get to know our Commercial team — what drives us, how we work, and what you can expect. https://careers.deliveroo.co.uk/the-commercial-team/
What You’ll Be Doing
You’ll be joining the Regional UK and Ireland team. We are the local experts responsible for driving Deliveroo’s performance across all four nations, managing the best restaurants from Brighton to Belfast to ensure we fulfil our massive growth potential.

s.h: Here’s what your day-to-day might look like
s.t:
Drive Partner Performance: Use data analysis and industry insights to maximise order volumes and unlock growth potential for our top restaurant partners.
Manage Senior Relationships: Build and maintain high-impact partnerships through consistent face-to-face and remote communication.
Negotiate High-Value Contracts: Lead commercial discussions to secure optimal terms of partnership and long-term value.
Optimise Operations: Liaise with restaurant and rider operations teams to identify and resolve friction points, improving overall efficiency.
Act as a Local Market Expert: Represent the face of Deliveroo within your region across Colchester, Chelmsford, Ipswich, and surrounding areas, staying ahead of industry trends to innovate and present new growth ideas.
What You’ll Need to Thrive
Our ideal candidate will bring strong expertise in some of these areas and curiosity to grow in others:
Significant Experience in Account Management: Proven track record in relationship management or a similar commercial role.
Strong Commercial Acumen: Comfortable interpreting data and using it to drive growth and inform business decisions.
Proven Negotiation Skills: Ability to manage complex conversations and deliver successful outcomes against targets.
Exceptional Communication: Natural ability to build rapport and influence stakeholders, whether in person, via phone, or email.
Operational Autonomy & Mobility: Self-starter comfortable working independently while travelling to meet partners across the region; holds a valid UK driving licence and access to a car.

At Deliveroo, you’ll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that’s constantly evolving. We’re food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to:
🔧 Make a visible impact every day Your work directly improves experiences for customers, partners and riders.
🌱 Learn fast in an entrepreneurial environment Work close to the market with autonomy, pace and real responsibility.
🧠 Build a career, not just a role Stretch yourself, develop new skills and grow as the business evolves.
🌎 Deliver together in an inclusive culture Collaborative, values-driven teams that support how you work best.
We aim to create a fair process that lets your skills shine—our interview typically includes 3-4 stages. Find more about how we hire here.
Our Global Structure
Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.
Diversity, Equity and Inclusion
At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We’re committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.
We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.
If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you’ll have the opportunity to let us know once you’ve submitted your application. We’ll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.
If you’re excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we’d love to hear from you!

You'll own a book of roughly 100 existing Enterprise customers across the Northeast — about $4M in ARR — and you'll be measured on what you do with it: how fast customers reach real adoption, how cleanly they renew, and how much you grow them.
This is a high-velocity motion. You're not nursing a handful of accounts through year-long cycles; you're keeping a wide book moving — spotting the renewal that needs attention three quarters early, the team that's underusing what they bought, the adjacent use case nobody's asked about yet. Breadth is the job. The best people in this seat are organized, proactive, and relentless about working the whole book rather than the five accounts that shout loudest.
You're measured against three things, the same three every Enterprise AM is measured against:
Time to value — getting customers to meaningful adoption and depth of use inside what they already own. You drive this; you don't wait for it.
Secure renewal — retention, multi-year capture, and forecast accuracy across your book.
Upsell and cross-sell — expansion within your existing customers: more users, adjacent products, new use cases inside the relationships you already hold.
When an expansion grows large enough that running it well would pull you off the other 99 accounts, you partner with an Account Executive who runs that single cycle while you keep the rest of the book healthy. You source it, set it up, hand it off cleanly, and step back in as the relationship owner when it closes. Knowing when to pass and passing well is part of doing this job at a high level — it's how you protect the book, not a limit on what you close.

s.t:
You know your book cold — which accounts are healthy, which are quietly at risk, and where the next expansion is hiding — without being asked.
Renewals are forecast accurately and captured early, not scrambled in the final 30 days.
You're generating expansion across the book consistently, not leaning on whichever pillar is easiest.
Your customers describe you as the steady, proactive presence who made the product work for them — not the person who showed up at renewal.

## **Das kannst du bewirken** ##
* Die dir zugeteilten Account Kunden (kleinere Ketten und strategisch wichtige Kunden) sowie die regulären Food Service Kunden in der Region **Zürich und Schaffhausen** betreust du professionell.
* Dein dir zugeteiltes Verkaufsgebiet in allen Bereichen managst du selbständig und unternehmerisch.
* Die Zielsetzungen vom Verkauf Food Service setzt du gekonnt um.
* Du akquirierst neue und strategische wichtige Shopper im Bereich Frische und Emmi Ice Cream.
* Du übernimmst die Kontrolle und das Management der auslaufenden und zu erneuernden Verträge.
## **Das bringst du mit** ##
* Du hast eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung im Lebensmittelbereich (z.B. Köchin/Koch Milchtechnologin/Milchtechnologe).
* Dein Verkaufsflair konntest du schon in einer ähnlichen Position beweisen und bringst Erfahrung im Aussendienst mit.
* Du bringst bereits erste Erfahrungen im Account Management und in der Kundenbetreuung mit.
* Du hast die Fähigkeit zur selbstständigen Planung und Durchführung von Jahresgesprächen und Kunden-Betreuung.
* Du besitzt einen gültigen Führerausweis (Kat. B).
* Du bist offen für Veränderungen, neue Herausforderungen, packst gerne an und bringst dich mit deinen Ideen ein.
## **Das bieten wir dir** ##
**6 Wochen Ferien**
Geniesse sechs Wochen Ferien pro Jahr. Ab dem 46. Lebensjahr steigert sich dein Urlaubsanspruch schrittweise auf bis zu sieben Wochen.
**Flexible Arbeitszeitmodelle**
Wir bieten verschiedene Arbeitszeitmodelle wie Gleit- oder Vertrauensarbeitszeit, um den persönlichen Bedürfnissen und Wünschen unserer Mitarbeitenden gerecht zu werden.
**Home Office**
Bei uns kannst du bis zu 40 % deiner Arbeitszeit (bei einer 100-%-Stelle) flexibel im Homeoffice verbringen, wobei wir dich als Arbeitgeberin bei der technischen Ausstattung für dein Homeoffice unterstützen.
**Attraktive Pensionskasse mit flexiblen Sparplänen**
Unsere Emmi Vorsorgestiftung verzinst dein Altersguthaben über dem gesetzlichen Minimum. Dein Beitrag basiert auf deinem Jahresgehalt - ohne Koordinationsabzug. Wähle zwischen Standard- oder Plus-Sparplan mit 1 % höheren Sparbeiträgen.
**Attraktive Zuschläge & Zusatzleistungen**
Du erhältst 20 % Zeitzulage ab 20 Uhr, bezahlte Aufwärmzeiten, eine Zeitgutschrift für Umkleidezeiten und eine faire Entschädigung für Piketteinsätze ausserhalb deiner Arbeitszeit.
**Individueller Entwicklungsplan**
Mit massgeschneiderten Entwicklungsplänen fördern wir gezielt deine individuellen Kompetenzen und unterstützen dein langfristiges Wachstum - ein zentraler Bestandteil unserer Nachhaltigkeitsstrategie. Erfahre mehr.

## Dein Bewerbungsprozess ##
Eingang deiner Bewerbung
Sobald deine Bewerbung online bei uns eingetroffen ist, erhältst du eine Eingangsbestätigung. Wir nehmen uns Zeit, jede Bewerbung sorgfältig zu prüfen. Sobald wir unsere Vorauswahl getroffen haben, geben wir dir zeitnah Bescheid.
Zeitversetztes Videointerview
Wir senden dir per E-Mail einen Link, über den du die vorab festgelegten Fragen bequem online mit deinem PC, Laptop oder Handy beantworten kannst. Das Video-Interview kannst du flexibel und ortsunabhängig absolvieren - ganz nach deinem Zeitplan.
Virtuelles oder persönliches Gespräch
Wir freuen uns, dich im Rahmen eines virtuellen oder persönlichen Gesprächs näher kennenzulernen.
Team-Kennenlernen
Dein zukünftiges Team freut sich darauf, dich persönlich kennenzulernen.
Ein Tag mit auf Tour
Begleite uns für einen Tag auf Tour, um einen Einblick in die Arbeitsabläufe und die Herausforderungen des Jobs zu erhalten.
Finaler Entscheid & Vertragsausstellung
Bei einer Zusage freuen wir uns, dir mündlich ein Vertragsangebot zu unterbreiten. Wenn wir uns einig sind, senden wir dir die Vertragskonditionen per E-Mail zu und bereiten deinen digitalen Arbeitsvertrag vor - der Beginn zahlreicher gemeinsamer Emmi Momente.

Votre rôle
En tant que Group Reservation & Sales Manager Multi-Site, vous êtes responsable du développement commercial et de la gestion des groupes pour nos établissements de Sion et de Fribourg.
Véritable interlocuteur(trice) privilégié(e) des entreprises, agences, tour-opérateurs et partenaires, vous prenez en charge les dossiers de la première demande jusqu’au départ du groupe et au suivi administratif et financier qui en découle.
Votre rôle combine développement commercial, vente, négociation, gestion des réservations groupes et coordination avec les équipes opérationnelles des deux établissements.
Vos missions

· Prospecter et développer de nouveaux clients groupes : entreprises, agences, tour-opérateurs, associations, clubs, etc.

· Développer et fidéliser un portefeuille de clients existants

· Identifier de nouvelles opportunités commerciales et marchés à potentiel

· Répondre aux demandes et appels d’offres groupes

· Élaborer des offres commerciales adaptées aux besoins des clients

· Négocier les tarifs, conditions et prestations dans le respect des objectifs de l’établissement

· Effectuer les relances commerciales et assurer un suivi régulier des prospects et clients

· Participer activement au développement du chiffre d’affaires groupes des deux établissements

s.t:

· Coordonner les prestations complémentaires : restauration, salles, pauses, boissons, etc.

· Anticiper les besoins spécifiques des groupes et proposer des solutions adaptées

· Assurer le suivi du dossier jusqu’à sa clôture

· Effectuer un suivi post-séjour afin de recueillir les retours clients et développer la relation commerciale

· Assurer le suivi administratif et financier des dossiers groupes

· Vérifier la conformité des prestations et tarifs facturés avec les offres et contrats

· Assurer le suivi des acomptes et échéances de paiement

· Contrôler les factures et identifier les éventuels écarts ou erreurs

· Effectuer les relances nécessaires en cas de factures ou acomptes impayés

· Collaborer avec la réception et la comptabilité pour assurer le suivi des dossiers

· Assurer le suivi des corrections, avoirs ou éventuelles réclamations liées à la facturation

· Veiller à la clôture administrative et financière des dossiers après le départ du groupe
