· Coordonner les dossiers avec les équipes réception, restauration et direction des différents sites

· Assurer une transmission claire et complète des informations aux équipes opérationnelles

· Veiller au bon déroulement des prestations vendues

· Harmoniser et améliorer les processus de gestion des groupes entre les deux établissements

· Suivre les demandes, confirmations, refus et opportunités commerciales

· Suivre le chiffre d’affaires généré par les groupes

· Analyser les performances et identifier les opportunités de développement

· Maintenir à jour les bases de données clients et le suivi de l’activité commerciale

· Participer aux actions commerciales, rendez-vous clients et événements professionnels
Votre profil

· Expérience dans la réservation groupes, le sales, le développement commercial ou l’événementiel hôtelier

· Expérience dans la gestion de groupes, un réel atout

· Excellent sens commercial et goût du challenge

· Aisance dans la négociation et la relation client

· Très bonnes capacités d’organisation, de suivi et de gestion des priorités

· Autonomie, rigueur et sens des responsabilités

· Esprit entrepreneurial, proactivité et force de proposition

· Capacité à gérer plusieurs dossiers simultanément

· Excellentes qualités relationnelles et de communication

· À l’aise avec les outils informatiques et les systèmes de réservation hôteliers

· Connaissance d’Opera Cloud et des outils de gestion hôtelière, un atout

· Très bonne maîtrise du français et de l’anglais

· Allemand, un réel atout

· Permis de conduire, un plus pour les déplacements entre les deux sites
Particularité du poste
Ce poste s’adresse à une personne ayant une véritable fibre commerciale et souhaitant jouer un rôle actif dans le développement des établissements.
Nous recherchons une personne capable de transformer une demande de groupe en opportunité commerciale, de négocier et vendre les prestations adaptées, puis d’assurer le suivi opérationnel, administratif et financier du dossier jusqu’à sa clôture.
La capacité à prospecter, vendre, fidéliser et développer le chiffre d’affaires est aussi importante que la rigueur nécessaire au suivi des dossiers.

Apollo.io is the leading go-to-market solution for revenue teams, trusted by over 500,000 companies and millions of users globally, from rapidly growing startups to some of the world's largest enterprises.

Founded in 2015, the company is one of the fastest growing companies in SaaS, raising approximately $250 million to date and valued at $1.6 billion.

Apollo.io provides sales and marketing teams with easy access to verified contact data for over 210 million B2B contacts and 35 million companies worldwide, along with tools to engage and convert these contacts in one unified platform.

By helping revenue professionals find the most accurate contact information and automating the outreach process, Apollo.io turns prospects into customers.

Apollo raised a series D in 2023 and is backed by top-tier investors, including Sequoia Capital, Bain Capital Ventures, and more, and counts the former President and COO of Hubspot, JD Sherman, among its board members.
Join Apollo as an Enterprise Account Executive (Founding Team). In this role, you’ll play a critical part in driving growth and guiding sales leaders and operations professionals through their evaluation of Apollo’s powerful, all-in-one sales platform.

Apollo.io is building its foundational team of sellers responsible for taking the company into the enterprise segment. In this full-cycle land, expand, and renew role, you will drive our growth into organizations with 1,000+ employees by acquiring new logos, retaining and renewing existing customers, and expanding accounts across your book of business.
As a founding member of this new segment, you’ll shape our motion, influence strategy, and set the standard for how Apollo wins in larger, more complex environments. This role is ideal for a high-performing seller who wants meaningful ownership, greenfield opportunity, and the ability to directly impact Apollo’s next phase of growth.

New Logo Acquisition
Own a defined set of enterprise accounts (1,000+ employees) as part of Apollo’s first team dedicated to this segment.
Proactively engage Director, VP, and C-suite leaders across Sales, Marketing and RevOps to build qualified pipeline and close new logos.
Partner with the Outbound BDR team to drive incremental pipeline.
Build a repeatable motion for engaging enterprise prospects as Apollo scales upmarket.
Achieve 3X pipeline coverage and exceed new business acquisition targets.
Account Expansion
Mature your understanding of your customers’ business goals to identify cross-sell and upsell opportunities.
Build account plans that maximize adoption and generate multi-year growth across your accounts.Partner with Customer Success, Product, and RevOps to ensure customers receive high-impact value that drives expansion revenue.Influence Apollo’s upmarket playbook by identifying expansion patterns and informing product and GTM strategy.
Revenue Retention & Renewals
Own renewals across your book of business with strong preparation, forecasting, and value-focused executive conversations.
Identify churn risks early and collaborate cross-functionally to drive adoption and prevent attrition.
Build multi-threaded relationships to ensure account stability and long-term success.
Sales Strategy & Execution
Use a data-driven approach to identify high-potential logo, expansion, and renewal opportunities.
Maintain precise pipeline hygiene and forecast revenue within a 10% accuracy margin.
Contribute to the development of Apollo’s enterprise GTM strategy through real-time insights from customer conversations.
Leverage Apollo’s platform and your outbound expertise to build meaningful relationships and position Apollo as a mission-critical revenue engine.
Mindset & Culture
Bring a “hunter + farmer” mentality - you’re equally strong in outbound acquisition and long-term account growth.
Thrive in a fast-paced, high-ownership environment where processes, playbooks, and systems are still being built.
Embrace a collaborative, ambitious, and customer-first culture.
Operate with a builder’s mindset: resourceful, solutions-oriented, and motivated by being part of a founding go-to-market team.

7+ years of quota-carrying AE experience, ideally with both new business and expansion ownership in GTM enterprise SaaS.
Consistent track record of exceeding quota across new business, expansions, and renewals.
Experience selling into enterprises (1,000+ employees) and navigating multi-threaded executive-level deals.
Fluency in sales methodologies such as Command of the Message and qualification frameworks like MEDDPICC.
Strong ability to manage the full customer lifecycle from prospecting to renewals, while maintaining a strategic and consultative approach.
High degree of ownership, grit, and adaptability suited for a founding team environment.
Excellent communication, executive presence, negotiation skills, and cross-functional partnership abilities.

Execute territory plans that target high-potential enterprise accounts, identifying the right entry points and accelerating deal velocity
Channel Partner Collaboration

Map accounts collaboratively with partner organisations to identify mutual pipeline and avoid duplication
Executive Engagement & Deal Leadership
Navigate complex enterprise organisations, building relationships across C-suite, IT, operations, procurement, digital transformation, and CX leadership
Act as a strategic advisor, helping enterprise buyers understand cloud migration options, communication infrastructure decisions, and the long-term value of Bandwidth's platform
Lead complex contract negotiations across legal, security, finance, and procurement stakeholders
Serve as the internal deal orchestrator - aligning resources across Product, Legal, Solutions Engineering, and Operations to structure and close
Marketing & Lead Generation Alignment
Work closely with marketing and demand generation teams to ensure outbound campaigns align with territory priorities
Provide field-level feedback on messaging, positioning, and market signals to inform campaign effectiveness
Leverage marketing-qualified leads alongside self-sourced pipeline to maintain a healthy and diversified funnel
Market & Product Intelligence
Maintain a strong and current understanding of Bandwidth's full product portfolio - voice, 911, messaging, and AI-enabled communications - and how they address enterprise operational and regulatory needs
Stay close to competitor positioning, pricing, and GTM dynamics across CPaaS, CCaaS, and CX markets
Provide informed feedback to internal teams on market positioning, competitive threats, and emerging enterprise buying patterns

Experience
Enterprise software, CPaaS, UCaaS, CCaaS, or telecom new logo sales experience
Consistent track record of meeting or exceeding quota on complex six- and seven-figure ARR deals
Demonstrated experience owning the full sales cycle - from self-sourced prospecting through commercial and contractual close
Proven ability to build and convert pipeline in competitive, technically complex sales environments
Consistent and demonstrable overachievement of sales goals and revenue targets
Market Knowledge
Deep understanding of the CPaaS, CCaaS, and CX market landscape - including key platform players, buying patterns, and enterprise decision drivers
Familiarity with leading enterprise CRM platforms and an understanding of how communications solutions integrate with or complement CRM ecosystems.
Solid knowledge of cloud migration dynamics, API-first platform architectures, and how enterprises evaluate and adopt communications infrastructure
Working knowledge of telecom fundamentals, including SIP, PSTN, voice infrastructure, and regulatory considerations such as E911
Sales Skills

This is an early-in-career opportunity intended for candidates with limited professional experience.
The CSAM is an **early-in-career Customer Success Account Manager **who delivers standardized customer success outcomes spanning executive partnership, solution health, cloud adoption, and AI acceleration activities. These CSAMs act within a pod model.
Working under the direction of senior CSAMs and a Manager, the CSAM operates within a defined pod covering a shared portfolio of accounts. The role contributes to portfolio-level intelligence, execution orchestration, and reactive signal aggregation - reducing context-switching for senior CSAMs and accelerating customer outcomes.
This is a talent-engine role: CSAMs are AI-first, customer-facing from month three, and grow through structured cohorts and community.

## Executive partnership and execution ##
* Execute standardized executive partnership, solution health, cloud adoption, and AI acceleration tasks under direct guidance from senior CSAMs or CSU leaders.
* Support agent and Copilot adoption motions across assigned pod accounts.
* Complete assigned activities accurately and on time; escalate exceptions rather than independently diagnose them.
## Portfolio-level intelligence and preparation ##
* Maintain deep, current account context across the pod-s defined portfolio.
* Synthesize account signals into -what-s changed / what matters now-
* Detect risks, upcoming deliveries, upcoming milestones, and open threads.
* Detect portfolio patterns such as recurring blockers across multiple accounts.
## Execution orchestration (not delivery) ##
* Track delivery and milestone progress with partners and CSAs on behalf of senior CSAMs.
* Map dependencies across workloads and milestones.
* Proactively flag drift before the customer raises it.
* Coordinate remediation follow-ups across internal teams.
## Reactive signal aggregation ##
* Monitor reactive support signals - case volume, aging, repeat drivers - across the pod portfolio.
* Aggregate reactive trends into portfolio-level views and surface early warnings of escalation risk.
* Track follow-through on Support, IM, and Service Manager commitments; chase stalled internal owners.
* Distill reactive noise into CSAM-ready insights, not raw data.
## Operating model ##
* Operate within a pod model covering a shared portfolio of accounts.
* Work under direct oversight of the Manager and senior CSAMs assigned to the pod.
* Limit interactions to task execution and information capture; executive partnership and account governance is led by the senior CSAM.

## Required ##
* Bachelor-s degree (any discipline) or equivalent early-career experience.
* 0-2 years of professional experience in program management, customer-facing operations, technology delivery, or analytics.
* Demonstrated comfort with AI tools and AI-first ways of working.
* Strong written and verbal communication in English plus the language(s) required for the assigned hub.
* Legally authorised to work in the location where this role is based - Zurich, Switzerland (Legally authorised = you hold citizenship or have been granted a valid visa or work permit.) Relocation expenses are not provided as part of this role.
* Fluency in English must be mandatory
* Fluency in French AND/OR German is mandatory

* Coursework or experience in program management, business operations
* Exposure to enterprise software, cloud platforms, or B2B customer success.
* Experience working in pod, squad, or matrixed team structures.

The mission
At Lucis , we believe healthcare should be preventive, not reactive. We’re building the OS for human longevity to help people add more healthy years to their lives. You can read more about who we are and how we work here .

Lucis is building its B2B distribution (department stores, wellness retail, premium clubs and studios, pharmacy networks..) and corporate licence accounts in France, the UK and beyond. Signing them is one job. Making them produce is this one.
You report to the Head of Sales & Partnerships, who stays accountable for portfolio performance and co-leads the enterprise accounts with you.
Your primary number: licences bought, then licences used. How many were purchased, and how many became a member who booked, got drawn and read their report. The first is this year's revenue. The second is whether it renews.
What you could own
Launch and activation: tracked code live, partner staff trained, launch communication shipped. Then a monthly review with every partner and account on licences bought and members activated, and a quarterly business review carrying a renewal and expansion plan.
The recurring book: corporate and enterprise licence accounts plus embedded partners, on adoption, activation rate, renewal and upsell.
Partner productivity: every partner carries a licence volume expectation and a date. You hold it, and you say out loud when a partner is not going to produce.
Member onboarding: from licence granted to first report read. The drop-off points, the reminders, the friction. With Product and Ops, who own the in-product mechanics.
Retention: no GRR or NRR baseline exists on this portfolio today. You define both, build them and report them.
Proof: documented reference cases the next deal is sold on. Honest results only, and never a health ROI claim.

You’re passionate about the future of human health and want your work to help people stay healthy for longer. You move quickly from idea to execution, take full ownership of what you build, and work best with talented people who care as much as you do.
You thrive in fast‑moving environments, learn by doing, and value feedback as a way to continuously improve. You use AI the way others use a calculator: naturally, to go faster and think bigger.
You’ll fit in well if
You have 4 to 8 years in account, partner or key account management, on a portfolio you carried and were measured on, not one you serviced.
You have moved activation, adoption or utilisation yourself, and can give the before, what you changed and the after. This is the core muscle of the job.
You run retention on numbers, and you can name the account you saved and the one you lost.
You have trained people you do not manage to sell your product, and you enjoy that part. The channel runs through a pharmacy counter, a store corner, a club front desk.
You have told a partner, or their sponsor, that they were not producing, with the data in hand.
You operate without an AE, an onboarding manager or a project manager behind you. Here there are none.
French and English both operational , spoken and written. Most partners are French, part of the portfolio is in the UK, the team is international.
We might not be a fit if

You've only worked in large, well-established companies.

At Lucis, AI isn't just our product, it's our engine. 100% of our teams are equipped with the best AI agents. You have carte blanche to explore and automate everything that can be, so you can focus exclusively on high-value work.

Across it all, we’ve embedded financial services tools at the point of sale, so merchants can access a business loan and manage their cash flow in one place.

Starlink was designed to connect the disconnected and this new product will greatly expand that mission by extending coverage to billions of existing cellular devices.
